passages.text: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him a second time: “Thus says the LORD who made the earth, the LORD who formed it and established it, the LORD is His name: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah a second time.
Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard.
The LORD is the one who made the earth.
The LORD formed the earth and established it.
The LORD’s name is the LORD.
The LORD said, “Call to Me.”
The LORD said, “I will answer you.”
The LORD said, “I will show you great things.”
The LORD said, “I will show you unsearchable things.”
The LORD said, “You do not know these things.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ עָצ֔וּר בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עֹשָׂ֑הּ יְהוָ֗ה יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֛הּ לַהֲכִינָ֖הּ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃ קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses of this city and the palaces of the kings of Judah that have been torn down for defense against the siege ramps and the sword: The Chaldeans are coming to fight and to fill those places with the corpses of the men I will strike down in My anger and in My wrath. I have hidden My face from this city because of all its wickedness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks about the houses in this city.
The LORD also speaks about the palaces of the kings of Judah.
People have torn down these buildings.
They used the materials to defend against siege ramps and the sword.
The Chaldeans are coming to fight.
The Chaldeans will fill these places with dead bodies.
I, the LORD, will strike down these men in My anger and in My wrath.
I have hidden My face from this city.
I did this because of all the wickedness in the city.
passages.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־ בָּתֵּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְעַל־ בָּתֵּ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה הַנְּתֻצִ֕ים אֶל־ הַסֹּלְל֖וֹת וְאֶל־ הֶחָֽרֶב׃ בָּאִ֗ים לְהִלָּחֵם֙ אֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּלְמַלְאָם֙ אֶת־ פִּגְרֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הִכֵּ֥יתִי בְאַפִּ֖י וּבַחֲמָתִ֑י וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הִסְתַּ֤רְתִּי פָנַי֙ מֵהָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את עַ֖ל כָּל־ רָעָתָֽם׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks about this city.
The LORD promises to act.
The LORD says, “I will bring health to this city.
I will bring healing to this city.
I will heal its people.
I will show them much peace.
I will show them much truth.”
passages.original: הִנְנִ֧י מַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֛הּ אֲרֻכָ֥ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א וּרְפָאתִ֑ים וְגִלֵּיתִ֣י לָהֶ֔ם עֲתֶ֥רֶת שָׁל֖וֹם וֶאֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: I will restore Judah and Israel from captivity and will rebuild them as in former times.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks about Judah and Israel.
Judah and Israel are in captivity.
The LORD will bring Judah back from captivity.
The LORD will bring Israel back from captivity.
The LORD will rebuild Judah and Israel.
The LORD will make them as they were before.
passages.original: וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִי֙ אֶת־ שְׁב֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת שְׁב֣וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנִתִ֖ים כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to act.
God will cleanse His people.
He will remove all their iniquity.
They committed these sins against God.
God will forgive all their sins.
He will forgive every act of rebellion against Him.
passages.original: וְטִ֣הַרְתִּ֔ים מִכָּל־ עֲוֺנָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־ לִ֑י וְסָלַחְתִּ֗י לְכוֹל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־ לִ֔י וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃

passages.text: So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Jerusalem.
God will restore Jerusalem.
God will bless Jerusalem with goodness and peace.
God will do many good things for Jerusalem.
All the nations of the earth will hear about these good things.
All the nations will know what God has done for Jerusalem.
Jerusalem will bring God a name of joy.
Jerusalem will bring God praise and glory.
The nations will hear about the goodness God gives Jerusalem.
The nations will be amazed and afraid.
The nations will tremble because of all the goodness God gives Jerusalem.
The nations will tremble because of all the peace God gives Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְהָ֣יְתָה לִּ֗י לְשֵׁ֤ם שָׂשׂוֹן֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְתִפְאֶ֔רֶת לְכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽנֹכִי֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וּפָחֲד֣וּ וְרָֽגְז֗וּ עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָה֙ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־ הַשָּׁל֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽנֹכִ֖י עֹ֥שֶׂה לָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: In this place you say is a wasteland without man or beast, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted—inhabited by neither man nor beast—there will be heard again the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD, saying: ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good; His loving devotion endures forever.’ For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times, says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD says these words.
You say this place is a wasteland.
You say there are no people here.
You say there are no animals here.
This place is in the cities of Judah.
This place is in the streets of Jerusalem.
These streets are empty.
No people live here.
No one sits here.
No animals are here.
But the LORD says something will happen.
People will hear sounds of joy here again.
People will hear sounds of gladness here again.
People will hear the voice of the bridegroom.
People will hear the voice of the bride.
People will hear voices giving thanks to the LORD.
These people will say, “Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD is good.
His love lasts forever.”
People will bring thank offerings into the house of the LORD.
The LORD says, “I will restore the land from captivity.
I will make it as it was before.”
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עוֹד֮ יִשָּׁמַ֣ע בַּמָּקוֹם־ הַזֶּה֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים חָרֵ֣ב ה֔וּא מֵאֵ֥ין אָדָ֖ם וּמֵאֵ֣ין בְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְחֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַֽנְשַׁמּ֗וֹת מֵאֵ֥ין אָדָ֛ם וּמֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב וּמֵאֵ֥ין בְּהֵמָֽה׃ ק֣וֹל שָׂשׂ֞וֹן וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֗ה ק֣וֹל חָתָן֮ וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּה֒ ק֣וֹל אֹמְרִ֡ים הוֹדוּ֩ אֶת־ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת כִּֽי־ ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔וֹ מְבִאִ֥ים תּוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־ אָשִׁ֧יב אֶת־ שְׁבוּת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: In this desolate place, without man or beast, and in all its cities, there will once more be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts is God over all armies and powers.
This place is now desolate.
No people live here.
No animals live here.
All its cities are empty.
The LORD of Hosts promises a change.
There will be pastures here again.
Shepherds will rest their flocks in these pastures.
Shepherds will find places for their sheep to lie down.
This will happen in all the cities of this land.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ ע֞וֹד יִֽהְיֶ֣ה׀ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הֶחָרֵ֛ב מֵֽאֵין־ אָדָ֥ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבְכָל־ עָרָ֑יו נְוֵ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים מַרְבִּצִ֖ים צֹֽאן׃

passages.text: In the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev, in the land of Benjamin and the cities surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD promises restoration.
There are cities in the hill country.
There are cities in the foothills.
There are cities in the Negev.
There is the land of Benjamin.
There are cities around Jerusalem.
There are cities of Judah.
In all these places, flocks will pass again.
Shepherds will count their sheep.
The LORD says this.
passages.original: בְּעָרֵ֨י הָהָ֜ר בְּעָרֵ֤י הַשְּׁפֵלָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֔גֶב וּבְאֶ֧רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה עֹ֣ד תַּעֲבֹ֧רְנָה הַצֹּ֛אן עַל־ יְדֵ֥י מוֹנֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is faithful.
The LORD made a gracious promise.
The LORD spoke this promise to the house of Israel.
The LORD spoke this promise to the house of Judah.
The LORD says, “Days are coming.”
In those days, I will fulfill My promise.
I will do what I said to Israel and Judah.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וַהֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתִּי אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
passages.sermon:
God spoke these words through the prophet Jeremiah.
God promised to act in the future.
God said, “In those days and at that time, I will do something for David.”
God will cause a Branch to grow from David’s line.
This Branch will be righteous.
This Branch will do what is just.
This Branch will do what is right in the land.
passages.original: בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אַצְמִ֥יחַ לְדָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צְדָקָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell securely, and this is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the future.
God promised to save Judah.
God promised to make Jerusalem safe.
In those days, Judah will be saved.
In those days, Jerusalem will live in safety.
People will call Jerusalem by a new name.
The new name will be “The LORD Our Righteousness.”
passages.original: בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן לָבֶ֑טַח וְזֶ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָא־ לָ֖הּ יְהוָ֥ה׀ צִדְקֵֽנוּ׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says: David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel, nor will the priests who are Levites ever fail to have a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD makes a promise.
David is the chosen king of Israel.
David will always have a descendant.
A man from David’s line will always sit on Israel’s throne.
The priests are Levites.
The Levite priests serve God.
The Levite priests will always have a man to serve before God.
A Levite priest will always offer burnt offerings to God.
A Levite priest will always burn grain offerings to God.
A Levite priest will always present sacrifices to God.
This will continue for all time.
passages.original: כִּי־ כֹ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֣ת לְדָוִ֔ד אִ֕ישׁ יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וְלַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֥ת אִ֖ישׁ מִלְּפָנָ֑י מַעֲלֶ֨ה עוֹלָ֜ה וּמַקְטִ֥יר מִנְחָ֛ה וְעֹ֥שֶׂה־ זֶּ֖בַח כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “This is what the LORD says: If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time, then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant and with My ministers the Levites who are priests, so that David will not have a son to reign on his throne.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said these words.
The LORD made a covenant with the day.
The LORD made a covenant with the night.
Day and night always come at their appointed times.
If you could break My covenant with the day and with the night,
If day and night did not come at their proper times,
Then you could also break My covenant with David My servant.
Then David would not have a son to reign on his throne.
Then you could also break My covenant with the Levites.
The Levites are priests who serve Me.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֽוֹר׃ כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ תָּפֵ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י הַלָּ֑יְלָה וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י הֱי֥וֹת יֽוֹמָם־ וָלַ֖יְלָה בְּעִתָּֽם׃ גַּם־ בְּרִיתִ֤י תֻפַר֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י מִהְיֽוֹת־ ל֥וֹ בֵ֖ן מֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ כִּסְא֑וֹ וְאֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים מְשָׁרְתָֽי׃

passages.text: As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD cannot be limited.
No one can count the stars in the sky.
No one can measure the sand on the seashore.
In the same way, no one can count the descendants of David, who is the LORD’s servant.
No one can measure the number of Levites who serve the LORD.
The LORD will make the descendants of David very many.
The LORD will make the Levites who serve Him very many.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִסָּפֵר֙ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְלֹ֥א יִמַּ֖ד ח֣וֹל הַיָּ֑ם כֵּ֣ן אַרְבֶּ֗ה אֶת־ זֶ֙רַע֙ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י וְאֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י אֹתִֽי׃ס

passages.text: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “Have you not noticed what these people are saying: ‘The LORD has rejected the two families He had chosen’? So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message.
The LORD said, “Jeremiah, look at what these people are saying.
They say, ‘The LORD chose two families.
Now the LORD has rejected them.’
They despise My people.
They do not see My people as a nation anymore.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃ הֲל֣וֹא רָאִ֗יתָ מָֽה־ הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ דִּבְּר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׁתֵּ֣י הַמִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּחַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם וַיִּמְאָסֵ֑ם וְאֶת־ עַמִּי֙ יִנְאָצ֔וּן מִֽהְי֥וֹת ע֖וֹד גּ֥וֹי לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: If I have not established My covenant with the day and the night and the fixed order of heaven and earth, then I would also reject the descendants of Jacob and of My servant David, so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore them from captivity and will have compassion on them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks.
He says, “I have made a covenant with day and night.
I have set the fixed laws of heaven and earth.
If I had not done this, then I would reject the descendants of Jacob.
I would also reject My servant David’s descendants.
I would not choose rulers from David’s family.
These rulers would not govern the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
But I will restore the people from captivity.
I will have compassion on them.”
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ לֹ֥א בְרִיתִ֖י יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה חֻקּ֛וֹת שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָ֖רֶץ לֹא־ שָֽׂמְתִּי׃ גַּם־ זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקוֹב֩ וְדָוִ֨ד עַבְדִּ֜י אֶמְאַ֗ס מִקַּ֤חַת מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים אֶל־ זֶ֥רַע אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִשְׂחָ֣ק וְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־ אָשׁוּב אֶת־ שְׁבוּתָ֖ם וְרִחַמְתִּֽים׃ס
